title: webshop-query-parser
summary: This skill extracts key constraints and product requirements from a user's shopping query. It should be triggered when the agent receives a new shopping instruction, to identify product attributes (e.g., 'gluten free'), price limits (e.g., 'lower than 140.00 dollars'), and other specifications. The skill outputs a structured set of search criteria to guide subsequent product discovery.
